$comment: Maturity: v1alpha1, may break with a changelog entry in api/README.md (ADR 0027). Internal: only the Workbench speaks it. ADRs: 0040 §1, 0046, 0055.
title: Rangelight terminal message v1alpha1
description: One WebSocket text frame between the Workbench and the api, on GET /v1alpha1/sessions/{session}/terminal with the subprotocol terminal.v1alpha1.rangelight.dev. The api bridges the frames to the NATS subjects pty.<session>.in and pty.<session>.out; the browser never reaches NATS or a pod (ADR 0040 §1). Bytes travel as base64, so any byte sequence, split anywhere, survives a text frame.

bytes.description: Raw bytes, standard base64 with padding: at most 48 KiB a frame.

input.title: Terminal input
input.description: Browser to api: what the member typed or pasted, for the PTY's stdin.

output.title: Terminal output
output.description: Api to browser: what the PTY wrote.

resize.title: Terminal resize
resize.description: Browser to api: the terminal's size in character cells changed.
